results.title: Sacrifice, discipline & tactical brilliance behind Maina's African boxing glory
results.description: Beyond managing his weight, Maina says the difference between domestic and international boxing requires fighters to develop different approaches, particularly when competing against opponents with varying styles, experience and tactical awareness which was another challenge in the just concluded championship.

results.title: In tight loss to Sixers, Pacers find identity for their short-handed period
results.description: The short-handed Pacers gave the effort they needed to give against the 76ers. It wasn't good enough but it does provide a template to follow.

results.title: Colts DT Adetomiwa Adebawore has chance at big payday after DeForest Buckner trade
results.description: Adetomiwa Adebawore has been playing 36% of the snaps for the Colts, but the DeForest Buckner trade opens an opportunity to prove himself as a starter
